newsitem.title: USA: Worldtalk sees Q2 shr loss $0.23 to $0.26.
newsitem.headline: Worldtalk sees Q2 shr loss $0.23 to $0.26.

text.p: Worldtalk Corp said Monday it expects to report a net loss ranging from $2.4 to $2.6 million, or a loss of $0.23 to $026 a share for the second quarter ended June 30, 1997.

The company reported a net loss of $326,000, or a loss of $0.03 a share for 1996 second quarter. Wall Street had expected the company to report a second quarter loss of $0.14 a share, according to First Call estimates.

The company, which provides directory-based messaging and security software solutions, said it expects to report revenues ranging from $2.3 to $2.5 million, compared to revenues of $3.3 million for the 1996 quarter.
It attributed its second-quarter 1997 expectation principally to a continued decline in the UNIX-based segment of its business.
The company said it plan to announce second-quarter results July 24.
